comment: Fallout 1 critical hit effects, extracted from the fallout1-ce reference (combat.cc: crit_succ_eff, pc_crit_succ_eff, attack_crit_success). tables[killType][hitLocation] (used for every non-player defender, by the defender's kill type) and player[hitLocation] (used when the defender is the player) each hold 6 entries indexed by effect level 0-5 (see effectLevelThresholds). damageMultiplier is in halves: a normal hit uses 2 and a critical replaces it with this value; per round damage = (weapon damage + Bonus Ranged Damage) * damageMultiplier / 2 (integer division), then * difficulty % / 100, then - DT, then - DR %, so 2 = x1, 3 = x1.5, 4 = x2, 5 = x2.5, 6 = x3, 8 = x4. flags: DAM_* effects always added to the defender (bit values in flagNames; 'bypass' = the target's DT and DR count as 0 unless the damage type is EMP). check: the reference's 'massive critical' roll; if check.stat is not null the defender rolls 1d10 and fails when the roll is greater than (that stat + check.modifier), then check.flags are added too and checkFailMessage replaces message; with stat null the check (modifier, flags, checkFailMessage) is ignored. message / checkFailMessage are combat.msg ids of the text appended to the critical hit line (verbose combat messages only). statNames maps the reference stat index 0-6 to the names used in check.stat. hitLocationPenalty is added to the to-hit chance (halved for melee and unarmed attacks) and subtracted from the critical chance (so an aimed shot gains +|penalty| % critical chance). 'uncalled' rows are never used by the reference: compute_attack turns an uncalled target location into torso before the critical roll.

effectLevelThresholds.note: Reference attack_crit_success(): roll = random(1..100) + the attacker's Better Criticals stat (base 0; the Better Criticals perk adds +20, the Heavy Handed trait subtracts 30, so the roll can fall below 1 or above 100). The effect level is the band whose inclusive [minRoll, maxRoll] contains the roll (null = unbounded): roll <= 20 -> 0, 21-45 -> 1, 46-70 -> 2, 71-90 -> 3, 91-100 -> 4, >= 101 -> 5, so level 5 needs a positive Better Criticals bonus. Exception: a defender with PID 0x01000008 is immune; the critical becomes a normal hit (multiplier 2, no table lookup).
